scripts.push:
local sess = ctx.session
local evId = ctx.event.id
local pDir = sess.playerDir

local dx = (pDir == 'E' and 1) or (pDir == 'W' and -1) or 0
local dy = (pDir == 'S' and 1) or (pDir == 'N' and -1) or 0

local nx = ctx.event.x + dx
local ny = ctx.event.y + dy

local row = sess.mapGrid[ny + 1]
local cell = row and row[nx + 1] or '#'

if cell == '#' then
    return
end

for _, other in ipairs(sess.currentMapData.events) do
    if other.x == nx and other.y == ny and other.name and other.name:find('Crate') then
        return
    end
end

ctx.event.x = nx
ctx.event.y = ny

local goals = { {3, 1}, {2, 5} }
local cratesOnGoal = 0

for _, other in ipairs(sess.currentMapData.events) do
    if other.name and other.name:find('Crate') then
        for _, g in ipairs(goals) do
            if other.x == g[1] and other.y == g[2] then
                cratesOnGoal = cratesOnGoal + 1
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

if cratesOnGoal == 2 then
    ctx.interpreter:queueCommand({ cmd = "OPEN_WINDOW" })
    ctx.interpreter:queueCommand({ cmd = "SET_TEXT", text = "YOU WIN!" })
    ctx.interpreter:queueCommand({ cmd = "WAIT", mode = "input" })
    ctx.interpreter:queueCommand({ cmd = "CLOSE_WINDOW" })
    ctx.interpreter:queueCommand({ cmd = "SCENE_EVENT", kind = "pop" })
end
